analysis.pairing: same patient IDs across compared models

statistical_methods.bootstrap: paired patient resampling; mean difference; percentile 95% CI
statistical_methods.wilcoxon: paired two-sided signed-rank, zero differences discarded

deployment_decision.rule: student if student_VAL_FG >= fusion_VAL_FG - 0.01; otherwise fusion
deployment_decision.teacher_artifact_sha256: teacher.pt model artifact hash verified on server via sha256sum

limitations: TEST50 statistics are exploratory analyses performed after TEST was opened; they do not alter selection and TEST was not rerun.
Cohort evidence is not clinical efficacy or external generalization.
No model weight bytes were copied or loaded during this analysis.
metrics_source: VAL18 final locked export manifests; TEST50 committed TEST_ONCE/TEST_TRANSACTION.json; patient-level macro values.
scope: Full-label FUSE: all TRAIN80 patients, 160 labeled ED/ES frames, 1,988 image-only cine frames; disjoint VAL18 and TEST50.

statistical_analysis.interval: paired patient bootstrap percentile 95% CI for mean difference
statistical_analysis.tests: paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, zero differences excluded

training.note: Selected epoch/update and T epoch are read from the final campaign evidence receipt; no TEST metric informed selection.
training.selection_basis: highest VAL18 fusion foreground Dice; ties earliest
training.selection_provenance: recomputed from validation rows in remote metrics.jsonl; max VAL18 fusion FG, earliest tie
